data.title: Income Tax Assessment for 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterwolgast issued the income tax assessment for 2024, dated 20 November 2026, setting the tax at €3,998.00 and resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €433.00 to be paid into the person's bank account.
data.explanation: This is the official calculation of your 2024 income tax. Because more wage tax was withheld than you actually owed, you are getting €433.00 back, which the tax office will transfer to the account on file. You do not need to do anything to receive it. If you think any figure in the calculation is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this above. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the assessment becomes final.
